headline: West Texas A&M concede ten in two matches
dek: West Texas A&M opened with four goals and a clean sheet against Adams State, and have since lost at home to Fort Lewis and away at Colorado Christian without scoring. Only Sul Ross State, beaten in both their matches, have let in as many.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Seven different players have scored Midwestern State's eleven goals, and Jose Ortiz has four of them.

wire.line: Oklahoma Christian remain unbeaten after three matches, and Newman are the only side to have scored against them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: All three of the season's score gaps are Lubbock Christian's: each match is marked final and carries no published score. Two more matches are past their date with no result at all, a separate absence and a separate count.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Dante Caffaro has kept two clean sheets in Oklahoma Christian's three matches and been beaten once.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas's defeat in Hawaii was their first of the season; they had won one and drawn one before it.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made eighteen saves for Sul Ross State and has yet to keep a clean sheet.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: St. Mary's have lost both their matches without scoring a goal.

last_match.line: Newman are the first side to score against Oklahoma Christian this season; they still visit Lubbock Christian and West Texas A&M before the month is out.

next_match.line: Dallas Baptist have yet to score this season and lost their only match at home to UT Tyler; Harding is their first trip away.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
